items.item_text: resume
cover letter
Required to hold a valid driver's license, have a driving record that is in accordance with local policies/procedures, and/or enroll in the California Employer Pull Notice Program.
High school diploma and / or equivalent certification / experience / training
Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training (Preferred)

The Security Supervisor 1 has responsibility over specific Community Safety Programs which operates and delivers non-sworn Safety Programs. The position performs administrative tasks to train and oversee part-time and professional staff. The Security Supervisor 1 coordinates with Police Department Leadership regarding special event planning.
Policy Development and Training - 20%

Participates in the development and monitoring of policies and procedures for various Safety Programs. Provide written documentation via internal memorandum and email for updates in policy. Organize and/or perform training for part-time & professional staff regarding policy updates and job expectations.
Staffing Analysis and Management - 30%

Analyzes and proposes safety staffing requirements, identifies / resolves work flow problems, recruits, trains, assigns work and schedules; recommends merit increases, salary adjustments and classification reviews.
Staff Meetings and Program Growth - 5%

Conducts staff meetings with campus safety shareholders. Analyze opportunities for growth of program, set goals and identify projects for staff members. Identify and address deficiencies in procedures, equipment, or compliance with policy.
Campus Liaison and Coordination - 5%

Liaison with campus departments to develop needs for specific services. Meet with Campus department representatives, correspond via email regarding appropriate responsibilities, duties and shift for personnel. Work with campus partners to appropriate UCPD management to coordinate improvement in Safety Programs.
Special Events Coordination - 20%
Coordinate with identified departments regarding their special events. Attend planning meetings. Advise campus departments on suggested safety staffing. Schedule overtime shifts for special events.
Safewalk Program Oversight - 20%
May oversee the administration and the organization of the Safewalk student employee program.
Actively cooperates and supports the work of others.
Must maintain valid CA DL and clean DMV record. If DL is Required, check DMV Pull Program above.
Customer service orientation to quickly address questions or issues.
Demonstrated leadership skills in mentoring and advising employees.
Knowledge of organization, HR and UC policies and processes.
Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities and execute plans to meet deadlines.
Knowledge and ability to monitor compliance with relevant regulatory agencies federal and state requirements.
Organizational skills to applied to coordinating assigned staff schedules and unit operations.
Interpersonal skills to effectively work well with others to achieve common goals.
Ability to apply judgement to quickly evaluate issues and on the spot identify a potential solution within defined procedures and policies.
Interpersonal skills to handle sensitive and / or stressful situations with a multi-cultural population and escalate appropriately.
